predictions.text: I predict that the presidential election in Kosovo will be won by an indirect election process, with no clear frontrunner emerging until the final days.

grade.line: Kosovo's Assembly settled the vote on 6 October, the day before this was foretold, after months of deadlock. The prediction named no candidate.
